items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: I used to see Harold Santiago. ... Like Harold and me, he'd come get me. ... Harold Santiago, he never played out of much for money, but he used to like good time and stuff. Yeah, he enjoyed playing for them.

ctx.x: I used to play with Walter Deco sometimes. Yeah, Walter played. Walter Deco.

Them were the, well, them piano players. Most any fellas would come up and play piano. You understand? Did they know many pieces, or just a couple of blues? Oh yeah, well there's the blues. They didn't want nothing but the blues. When you play the piano in the supper, they wanted the blues singing like High Long and all different things like that, you know. It was more the blues. Stagger Lee and Billy Lyon and all that. That's all they would. Well any of them fellas would come up and get in there. See, there…
